topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement's complexity and importance.

topics.label: Fundamentals of the complement system and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the overall organization of complement, its historical nomenclature conventions, and the pivotal role of C3 activation.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the alternative, lectin, and classical pathways that initiate complement and converge to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the major downstream functional outcomes of complement activation, including opsonization, inflammation, and membrane lysis.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct clinical presentations and disease susceptibilities associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms pathogens utilize to circumvent complement-mediated destruction, highlighting Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture closing and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and provides a brief preview of the upcoming lecture topic.
